notes.title: Release 1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed issues where button mashing would let you control entities you shouldn't, causing crashes or softlocks.
[*] Added basic retro snes controller support
[*] Fixed a bug with Sea where Luna can disappear till the game is reloaded
[*] Fixed a bug where after defeating W, he would give you rides like nothing happened (causing crash).
[*] Fixed more text issues
[*] In Moon, prevent movement during intro cine.
[*] Angel Tear, Angel Lament and Phoenix Tear now report proper numbers for healing.
[*] W duplicates now exit battle properly
[*] Sentries will now tell you they can't be used instead of wasting MP
[*] Phoenix Tear FX fixed
[*] Teleport orb now resets animations properly
[*] Fixed a crash where bushes on top of you would cause entities to crash when using abilities
[*] Fixed a crash when canceling the tournaments menu
[*] Upgraded Wolf to newer version, improving reporting capabilities.
[/list]

notes.title: Release 1.0.1
notes.content:
Just released 1.0.1 which fixes a few bugs which have popped up over the last few days. Thanks for all the feedback!

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where AIOps would overwrite other lua tables (would cause crashes fighting Leviathan)
[*] Fixed being able to walk underneath house walls in Sky - Residential
[*] Tweaked Sky I enemies
[*] Some grammar fixes
[/list]
